about_the_game:
January 18 – Update for International Players

Message to International Players

To our international players,

When installing the English demo of TOGATSUNAGI Chapter 1, a bug may cause the Japanese version to be installed instead.

As a solution, we are currently integrating an in-game language switching feature and unifying the builds.

This implementation will take a little time. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

As a temporary workaround, the English version is available on itch.io.

Please search for “TOGATSUNAGI”, and it should appear in the results.

Additionally, we are currently contacting support to request changes to the game title localization.

Thank you very much for your understanding and continued support.

About This Game

This is a story-driven 2D action fantasy game. Players switch between a female swordswoman and a gunner as the protagonist, fighting against a continuous stream of monsters.

Please enjoy the story woven by attractive character illustrations and unique characters.

A series of four episodic releases are planned, with the currently available content being a prologue and serving as a demo version.

The game features multiple endings.

This work is created with RPG Maker MZ, and the play time is not yet determined.

Please be aware that the game contains grotesque expressions; those sensitive to such content should exercise caution.

Story

The righteous nation of Hyuiria(pronounced: Hyoo-I-ria), home to people who worship the goddess of justice Hyustiria(pronounced: Hyoo-STI-ria), had long protected its citizens from the monstrous beings known as Mamono by using the magic-imbued device called the Magic Conduit to project a barrier across the entire country.

However, one day, someone forced the Conduit to shut down, causing the barrier that covered the nation to vanish and allowing Mamono to enter freely.

During this turmoil, the protagonist Rinka, who had set foot in a foreign land in search of her younger brother, reunited with her childhood friend Ryu, who happened to be visiting the same country. But before they could understand what was happening, the two were caught in a sudden Mamono attack and lost consciousness.

When they awoke in an unfamiliar place, the one who appeared before them was their former friend Alto.

The two learned that everything that had happened was orchestrated by him—and that he had bound them with the Power to Link Lives, a force that caused them to share each other’s wounds, pain, and even their very life.

The only way to reactivate the Conduit and break the bond placed upon them was to kill their once-beloved friend Alto.

Though hesitant to kill a friend, Rinka and Ryu pursue Alto to save the nation and free themselves—but in doing so, they slowly begin to witness the true nature of the so-called “nation of justice.”

Live Streaming and Prohibited Actions

■Regarding Secondary Distribution of the Game

Secondary distribution of the game is strictly prohibited.

Unauthorized reproduction or secondary distribution of in-game images, music, or assets is also prohibited.

The copyrights of borrowed materials belong to their respective creators.

The author is not responsible for any damages or disadvantages arising from this work.

We appreciate your understanding in advance.

■Regarding Live Streaming

Advance notice is not required, and you are free to live stream.

However, please adhere to the following terms and conditions.

Failure to comply may result in a request to remove the video.

Prohibited Actions for Live Streaming

■Live Streaming/Broadcasting of Clear Bonus Content

The clear bonus content is a special gift for those who play the game. Please refrain from live streaming.

Viewing live broadcasts is also prohibited. This also applies to viewing with the screen hidden.

*Posting images or text of the clear bonus content on social media is also prohibited.

■Streams that Slander or Abuse the Work

Streams that, even unintentionally, end up slandering or abusing the work are prohibited.

■Titles Containing Spoilers

While it is possible to use still images from the game as thumbnails, please avoid those that contain spoilers about the content.

▼ Please be sure to include the game title in your video titles.

■ Fan art is highly welcomed, but please refrain from creating works that encourage criminal acts.

■ Critical feedback will be sincerely considered, but excessively harsh comments may be deleted.

■ Credits are listed in the main game.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains gore, murder, and other grotesque depictions. It also contains discriminatory depictions of imaginary creatures and races.
